requirements.description: User explicitly wants a location near public transport. 71 is the rounded 75th percentile (70.93) of the mobility distribution.
A university student residence clearly needs nearby universities and schools. 75 is the rounded 75th percentile (75.14) of the education distribution.

The user prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. Gross floor area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), public transport proximity and the CDP/PNRR funding context are not energy requirements and are not filtered here.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold per occupant was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class and public transport proximity are outside the reference columns and are handled elsewhere. Turin is a city, so it is not mapped to comune_code and is left to the Location Agent.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the office property type, surface area of at least 850 sqm, energy classes A1 to C, mobility score of at least 71, and education score of at least 75. The location constraint is a 3.0 km haversine radius around the supplied coordinates, and results are ordered by distance from that point. No city-name predicate is used, and the 60-person capacity is not applied because it is not among the extracted requirements.
